name: Browse a structured Lil Guys specimen
description: Verifies the public atlas can find a known archive file, open it, parse at least one run, and expose the three Suno-facing prompt sections.
steps: Wait for Corpus Telemetry and the Specimen Cabinet to finish loading
Search for "Bigfoot Mothman" and open the matching markdown specimen
Verify a parsed run appears, then switch from STYLE to LYRICS / CONTROL and CAPTION
expected: The drawer shows a Little Guy run with its seed/engine information and all three prompt tabs can be opened without leaving the atlas.

name: Filter the specimen cabinet on mobile
description: Verifies the archive remains usable on a phone-sized screen and can be narrowed by both kind and filename/date.
expected: Only matching session records remain visible and their cards are readable and tappable in the mobile layout.

name: Read the experiment method explainer
description: Verifies a visitor can understand the experiment before diving into raw run data.
steps: Open HOW THIS MUTATES from the top navigation
Read the process map through the SUNO triptych stage and the recurring laws section
Use ENTER THE ARCHIVE to return to the specimen cabinet
expected: The explainer visibly describes the seed-to-engines-to-constraints-to-Suno process and returns the visitor to the archive.

name: Show a useful archive failure state
description: Verifies the site reports a backend/archive failure instead of silently rendering an empty exhibit.
steps: Load the site while the archive endpoint returns the simulated failure
Verify a RETRY SIGNAL control is offered
expected: The page visibly says "Archive signal lost." and offers RETRY SIGNAL.
